page.overview:
Who is Agent Chase?

Agent Chase is the main protagonist in the themes Agents and Agents 2.0.

Chase has a dual-sided face: on the front side, he is seen with tinted sunglasses and a smirking expression; on the flip side of his head, he is seen without glasses and with a frowning mouth. In the sets 8633 Mission 4: Speedboat Rescue and 8636 Mission 7: Deep Sea Quest, as well as LEGO Battles: Ninjago, he has only his alternate frowning face, which is a common head used in other LEGO themes.

Agent Chase is a team leader and top field agent who specializes in hazardous missions. He is experienced with life-threatening situations while always remaining calm, although he will act with urgency when necessary. He quickly comes up with plans and finds solutions to his problems.

Agent Chase partakes in six of the original eight missions. In Mission 1, Agent Chase chases Saw Fist in a Jetpack. In Mission 4, Chase has to rescue Agent Trace from Break Jaw and his robotic sharks. In Mission 5, Chase must steal a laptop containing Dr. Inferno's latest plans for taking over the world. In Mission 6, Chase and his fellow Agents have to stop Dr. Inferno from escaping the High-Security Jail built into the center. In Mission 7, Chase has to recover some treasure. In Mission 8, Chase has to rescue Agent Fuse as well as destroying the laser of Dr. Inferno's Volcano Base hideout.
